nodes.label: Logo Plataforma Geo e Inovação - DIRAG/GERAG (image/geo.png)
nodes.rationale: Official vertical brand poster/logo for 'PLATAFORMA GEO e INOVAÇÃO / DIRAG/GERAG': dark green (#01781E) hybrid tree with circuit-board traces on the left and organic leaves on the right, over a sky-blue (#74D5F8) to turquoise (#6DDECF) vertical gradient, anchored by a Banco do Brasil-style blue (#262DA7) geometric emblem and stacked uppercase typography. Embedded in the topbar of interface.html and specified in guia_estilo.md.

nodes.rationale: Visual color system uniting Banco do Brasil institutional blue (#262DA7) and highlight yellow (#FAFD00) with environmental green (#01781E), sky blue (#74D5F8), and turquoise (#6DDECF) — shared across logo_bb.png, geo.png, and guia_estilo.md.
